Subject: Follow-up & initial acceptance gates (legal -> security -> finance -> PO)

Hi Alice / James —

Thanks again for a productive discovery today. Quick recap and a proposed simple mutual action plan so we can align procurement expectations and surface any blockers early.

High-level: BluePeak is leaning toward a standard PO purchase (vs. card) and will require a short SOW + SOC 2 evidence before finance will issue a PO. You mentioned marketplace is not a priority this cycle but may be interesting later.

Proposed acceptance gates and approximate timeline (please confirm):
- Legal review of SOW & T&Cs — 1–2 weeks (owner: BluePeak legal)
- Security review (SOC 2 + redlines) — 2–3 weeks (owner: BluePeak infosec)
- Finance approval & PO issuance — 1 week after legal clears (owner: BluePeak finance)

Asks from our side:
- Confirm primary procurement contact (email) — I included procurement@bluepeak for now.
- Confirm whether BluePeak needs a standalone SOW or if a short statement in a PO is sufficient.
- Whether there are any specific audit artifacts beyond SOC 2 (encryption at rest keys, data residency constraints).

Attachments: I uploaded a first-pass MutualActionPlan-v1.xlsx and an initial SOW-draft.pdf for your team to review.

Next steps: I’ll consolidate and send an updated MPA with explicit milestone owners and target dates once you confirm the above. If it helps, I can propose two commercial paths in writing (PO path and expedited card path) with cost/pricing differences and onboarding SLAs.

Available for a 20–30 minute follow-up this week if you want to walk the timeline with procurement. Calendly: https://cal.com/redwood/demo-30

Thanks —

Thanks, Aditya — good summary. A few clarifications from procurement / legal: 

- Procurement contact is procurement@bluepeak.com (copied). James Ortiz will own legal review.
- We do prefer a PO for enterprise purchases. Card purchase only for pilots <$5k; not applicable here.
- Legal will require a short SOW (1–2 pages) that references Redwood standard T&Cs; expect 7–10 business days for review if there are no material commercial redlines.
- Security: we require SOC 2 Type II and a short response to a lightweight questionnaire; our infosec team will run the questionnaire in parallel with legal. Target 10–15 business days.
- Finance: once legal signs off, finance typically issues PO within 5 business days.

Timeline target (internal): legal complete by 2026-11-23, security questions complete by 2026-12-02, PO issuance by 2026-12-09. These are optimistic but give us a working schedule.

Please send the SOW trimmed to the key deliverables and a clear acceptance criteria section. Also confirm whether Redwood requires any data processing addendum (we will want DPS/DPA language).

I’ll review the attachments tonight and feed back any redlines by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
